name: Hollis
title: Animal Keeper
desc: Cuidador del ganado, cabras y gallinas. Otorga misiones de animales y sube Ganadería.
quote: Easy there. The goats don't know you yet. Move slowly round them.

name: Greta
title: Schoolteacher
loc: Escuela del Pueblo (Norte de los campos)
desc: Maestra del pueblo. Enseña a los niños letras y números en el patio de la escuela.
quote: Hello! Walking, not running, I hope. I teach the children letters and good manners.

name: Cole
title: Farmhand
desc: Ayudante del corral. Alimenta las vacas y da misiones de tala de madera.
quote: I work the paddock for Hollis. Feeding, mucking out, the lot.

name: Dara
title: Orchard Keeper
desc: Cuidadora del huerto de frutas. Donde se esconde la gallina traviesa de Hollis.
quote: Cherries, oranges, and apricots. Don't climb the trees, I know you want to.

name: Fern
title: The Greenhouse
loc: Invernadero de Cristal (Norte de la plaza)
desc: Cuida las plantas exóticas dentro del invernadero.
quote: Mind the glass! The soil in here stays warm all year.

name: Hugo
title: The Miller
desc: Muele el trigo cultivado para producir harina para la panadería.
quote: Wind's good today. Bring me wheat and I'll keep the stones turning.

name: Bram
title: The Forge
desc: Vende picos de bronce, oro y amatista. Compra minerales y metales.
quote: Afternoon. You look like you could swing a pick.

name: Odette
title: General Store
desc: Compra casi todo. Administra los 6 pedidos diarios (+25% oro y XP).
quote: Oh, it's you. Wood, stone, a loaf for the road? What will it be?

name: Hazel
title: Seed & Tool
loc: Tienda de Semillas (Este de la plaza)
desc: Venta de semillas agrícolas y herramientas estándar.
quote: Seeds, hoe, watering can... What are you planting today?

name: Pell
title: Carpenter
desc: Vende madera y compra excedentes. Da misiones de puentes.
quote: Hang on, let me put this down. Bring me wood!

name: Wren
title: Fisher
desc: Vende cañas de pescar y compra todo tipo de peces por oro.
quote: Got a minute? Sit. I want to tell you about a fish.

name: Tamsin
title: The Bakery
desc: Estufa pública para cocinar recetas y recuperar energía.
quote: Fresh from the oven! Come by tomorrow and there'll be soup.

name: Juniper
title: The Apothecary
desc: Vende semillas de hierbas y flores (Caléndula req. Cultivo 5).
quote: Don't touch the blue jars. If a jar starts humming, tell me.

name: Rowan
title: The Market Hall
desc: Puestos libres para vender cultivos a otros jugadores y comprar cofres.
quote: The stalls are yours. Set your own price in Gold or Shards.

name: Farthing
title: The Bank
desc: Bóveda para guardar tu oro de forma segura.
quote: Safe and sound. Not a single coin has ever gone missing here.

name: Quill
title: The Exchange
desc: Intercambio de recursos y monedas entre jugadores.
quote: Swaps, rates and trades. Everything has its balance.

name: Ivy
title: Flower Seller
desc: Vendedora de flores y receptora de la misión 'Día de Mercado'.
quote: Fresh flowers! Grown right here in Bloomshire.

name: Maren
title: The Elder
loc: Casa en orilla oeste del río
desc: La anciana líder del pueblo. Da las misiones principales de la historia.
quote: Welcome, newcomer. The river brought you to us for a reason.

name: Marlow
title: The Old Farmer
loc: Huertos del oeste / Entrada de isla
desc: El granjero veterano. Te enseña a cultivar y regalar herramientas.
quote: Soil's like me. Slow, but it gets there.

name: Dunn
title: Head Miner
desc: Jefe de los mineros en Stonepeak. Desbloquea misiones de cuevas.
quote: Watch your step in the deep levels. The spiders bite hard.

name: Nixie
title: The Mermaid
desc: Sirena del pueblo. Pide un Pez Dorado en su cadena de favores.
quote: Cold water, warm heart. Have you seen the river glitter?

name: Marven
title: The Lake Mermaid
desc: Sirena guardiana del lago. Pide el estuche de los Fundadores.
quote: The Founders remember me. Bring me what was taken.

name: Celeste
title: The VIP Shop
desc: Vende el Cofre VIP decorativo por 150.000 de oro.
quote: Nexus! Lovely to see you. I polish this counter twice a day.

name: Augustin
title: The VIP Exchange
desc: Intercambios exclusivos para miembros VIP y Fundadores.
quote: Only the finest rates for our distinguished patrons.

name: Silas
title: The Gravedigger
desc: Sepulturero. Conoce secretos de las tumbas antiguas.
quote: Quiet work. The ground remembers everyone.

name: Mabel
title: Pond Keeper
desc: Cuida los estanques y lirios de agua.
quote: Keep an eye on the bridge, the planks get slippery.

name: Ansel
title: Chapel Keeper
desc: Guardián de la capilla y campanas.
quote: Peace to you, friend. Take a moment to rest.

name: Fenwick
title: Postmaster
desc: Cartero de Bloomshire. Entrega cartas y correspondencia.
quote: Letters! Always moving, always on time.

name: Otto
title: Lamplighter
desc: Enciende las farolas y da la misión 'Día de Mercado'.
quote: A light for every corner before the dark comes.

name: Lena
title: Gardener
desc: Cuida los macizos de flores en el centro del pueblo.
quote: The roses are blooming early this season!

name: Rosa
title: Reader
desc: Lectora apasionada de las historias de los Fundadores.
quote: Reading the old logbook... It's fascinating.

name: Jasper
title: Boatwright
desc: Carpintero de barcos y muelles.
quote: Keep the timber dry and the seams caulked.

name: Felix
title: Fiddler
desc: Músico ambulante que toca melodías folclóricas.
quote: A tune for a coin? It keeps the spirits high.

name: Rhys
title: Farmhand
desc: Ayudante en la cosecha de patatas y trigo.
quote: Hard work, but the earth gives back what you put in.

name: Clara
title: Baker
desc: Segunda panadera de tartas y pasteles.
quote: The pies are hot, careful with your hands!

name: Elsie
title: Painter
desc: Pinta paisajes de Bloomshire.
quote: The light over the river at dusk is perfection.

name: Willa
title: Beekeeper
desc: Apicultora encargada de la miel y colmenas.
quote: Listen closely... they're humming in tune.

name: Faelan
title: Bloom Warden
desc: Guardián de los límites salvajes del bosque.
quote: Don't wander too deep into the hollow without a blade.

name: Liora
title: Fountain Singer
desc: Canta junto a la fuente de la plaza.
quote: Water has memory, if you know how to listen.

name: Aurel
title: Tomb Keeper
desc: Custodio de los monumentos funerarios.
quote: Respect the quiet. The founders rest here.

name: Nella
title: Stallkeeper
desc: Vendedora ambulante de especias y frutos secos.
quote: Try a sample! Sweet and salty.

name: Teodor
title: Fruit Seller
desc: Comerciante de manzanas y frutas de temporada.
quote: Picked this morning, sweet as honey.

name: Brenna
title: Mason
desc: Cantera y talladora de piedra.
quote: Good stone rings true when struck with a mallet.

name: Sefa
title: Shepherd
desc: Pastora de ovejas y lana.
quote: Mind the sheep, they startle easily.

name: Corin
title: Vintner
desc: Productor de jugos y bebidas fermentadas.
quote: The grapes need another week of warm sun.

name: Pim
title: Fisher
desc: Joven pescador de percas.
quote: I swear I saw a golden tail under the bridge!

name: Oriel
title: Pilgrim
desc: Viajero que busca los altares sagrados.
quote: May your harvests be peaceful and plentiful.

name: Aldous
title: Scholar
desc: Historiador de los primeros colonos de Bloomshire.
quote: The scrolls hold truths long forgotten by most.

name: Hakon
title: Ice Fisher
desc: Pescador sobre hielo en aguas profundas.
quote: The cold preserves the bite of the biggest trout.

name: Sigrun
title: Smith
desc: Aprendiz de forja y afiladora de herramientas.
quote: Keep the coals breathing, keep the steel true.

name: Bjorn
title: Woodcutter
desc: Leñador de troncos gruesos de arce.
quote: Timber! Clear the path!

name: Ylva
title: Path Keeper
desc: Mantiene los senderos de montaña libres de derrumbes.
quote: Watch the loose gravel near the gorge.

name: Gunnar
title: Elder
desc: Minero veterano jubilado.
quote: I remember when the Green Vein was first struck.

name: Liv
title: Musician
desc: Flautista nocturna junto al agua.
quote: The fish rise to the surface when the song is gentle.

name: Toke
title: Watchman
desc: Vigilante de la entrada a las montañas.
quote: All clear on the eastern trail tonight.

name: Inga
title: Fishmonger
desc: Venta de pescado fresco del día.
quote: Caught at dawn, on your plate by noon!

name: Eira
title: Hunter
desc: Cazadora de Whisperwood.
quote: Forty years hunting this wood. Deer at the glade, boar in the south.

name: Sylvie
title: The Library
desc: Archivera y bibliotecaria oficial.
quote: Silence, please. Every book has a soul.

name: Pemberton
title: The Manor
desc: Mayordomo de la mansión señorial.
quote: Good day. Do you have an appointment with her ladyship?

name: Theo
title: The Golden Boat
desc: Navegante de las islas lejanas.
quote: Beyond the mist, new shores await.

name: Iris
title: The Celestial Garden
desc: Cuidadora de las flores nocturnas.
quote: The moonflower opens only when the world sleeps.

name: Lady Amelia
title: Resident
desc: Noble benefactora de Bloomshire.
quote: A delightful afternoon for a stroll through the village.

name: Wick
title: The Ferryman
desc: Barquero de los canales secundarios.
quote: Step aboard carefully, the river runs deep.

name: Sable
title: The Night Market
desc: Comerciante misteriosa de objetos raros.
quote: Looking for something the daylight merchants don't sell?

name: Vesper
title: The Lamplighter
desc: Farolero de los muelles.
quote: Keeping the fog at bay, one flame at a time.

name: Jory
title: Old Sailor
desc: Marinero retirado que narra historias de monstruos marinos.
quote: Ahoy! Sit down, sit down. Let me tell you about the storm of '14.

name: Tilly
title: The Tailor
desc: Teje telas en el telar y confecciona ropas y capas.
quote: A stitch in time! Wool, cloth and thread for every season.
